facts: All new code lives in the UI package `ui/` (React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind 3, Vite 6). The UI never imports from the server package `src/` or from `cli/`; it keeps its own copy of any shared type.

ui/tsconfig.json: strict, noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, moduleResolution bundler, allowImportingTsExtensions, jsx react-jsx, and `include: ["src"]` only. Relative imports therefore carry their extension, exactly like the existing code: `import type { Entity } from './types.ts'`, `import WherePage from './WherePage.tsx'`.

ESLint runs from the repo root with zero allowed warnings and its typed rules cover `**/*.ts` only, so `.tsx` files are not linted. In a `.ts` file: `@typescript-eslint/consistent-type-imports` (use `import type`), `@typescript-eslint/no-floating-promises` (await or `void` every promise), and the recommendedTypeChecked set including no-unsafe-assignment and no-unsafe-member-access, which are NOT switched off for ui/.

Tests use vitest ^2.1.8 with `globals: true`, the jsdom environment and `ui/src/test-setup.ts` (which imports @testing-library/jest-dom), all configured in ui/vite.config.ts. Import what you use anyway: `import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'`. Render with @testing-library/react and drive input with `userEvent.setup()` from @testing-library/user-event ^14.

Existing UI patterns to follow: `ui/src/lib/api.ts` (`createApiClient`, the private `request` helper, bearer auth and the 401 logout), `ui/src/hooks/useQueue.ts` (the poll pattern with a `cancelled` flag and `clearInterval`), `ui/src/components/TasksPage.tsx` and its test (page with an `api: ApiClient` prop, stubbed as `{ ... } as unknown as ApiClient`).

Styling matches the existing dark pages: Tailwind utility classes such as `bg-gray-950`, `bg-gray-900`, `border-gray-800`, `text-gray-400`, `text-xs`, `rounded-md`. No new dependency may be added to ui/package.json.
The page must work down to 360 px wide: one column, no horizontal scrolling, long paths wrap (`break-all` or `break-words`).

Do not edit the protected feature test `ui/tests/where-page.feature.test.tsx`, `changes/004-ui-where/slice-check.mjs`, `specs/constitution.md`, `specs/constitution.approval.json`, anything else under `changes/` or `.tinysdd/`, nor files of accepted slices unless this brief says so. Do not delete files.

The slice check runs `node changes/004-ui-where/slice-check.mjs <files>`: Vitest with `--root ui` on the slice test, ESLint `--max-warnings=0` on the listed `.ts` files and `tsc --noEmit -p ui/tsconfig.json`. Call the run_checks tool before you finish and fix every reported error. Do not create helper or probe files to run checks; use run_checks.

The protected feature test `ui/tests/where-page.feature.test.tsx` is the final acceptance. Read it: it pins the exact strings, the `<section>` per group with its level-2 heading, the `aria-pressed` view buttons, the `Show released and done` checkbox and the `Copy resume command` button. It lives outside ui/src on purpose, so `tsc -p ui/tsconfig.json` never typechecks it.
